title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: A heavily pregnant meerkat (Suricata suricatta) is weighed by field researchers at the Kalahari Meerkat Project, South Africa. See ‘The ecology of gestational growth in a wild cooperative mammal’ (https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2656.70199) for more information.
